newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal telecoms appeal to investors - minister.
newsitem.headline: Portugal telecoms appeal to investors - minister.

text.p: Portugal's telecommunications sector appeals to investors because it is growing rapidly and constantly innovating, Planning Minister Joao Cravinho said.
"Telecommunications is growing rapidly. The sector is a leader in commercial and technological innovation," he told reporters.
Commenting on the recent rise in Portugal Telecom's share price, he said: "It reflects the view that telecommunications has enormous potential."
Portugal Telecom eased 18 escudos to 4,917 in volume of 142,796 shares on Lisbon bourse at 1110 GMT.
